description: List pending removals that can still be undone. type 'partial' = qualities/backup removed with panda_request_partial_deletion (cancel with panda_cancel_partial_deletion); 'video' = whole videos in the trash; 'all' (default) = both. Returns {retention_days, partial_deletions, pagination}.
name: panda_list_partial_deletions
title: List Partial Deletions
